description: This file defines the 'freetag' class, an implementation of a tagging system for content within a social website, with methods to manage tags, objects, and related functionalities.

classes.name: freetag
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a customizable tagging system for objects within a database-driven application.

methods.name: get_objects_with_tag
methods.description: Returns object IDs tagged with a specified normalized tag, optionally filtering by tagger ID, with pagination.

methods.name: get_objects_with_tag_all
methods.description: Retrieves all object IDs tagged with a specified normalized tag, ignoring pagination.

methods.name: get_objects_with_tag_combo
methods.description: Returns object IDs that are tagged with all tags in a provided array, optionally filtering by user.

methods.name: get_objects_with_tag_id
methods.description: Returns object IDs associated with a specific tag ID, optionally filtered by tagger.

methods.name: get_tags_on_object
methods.description: Retrieves tags assigned to a specific object, with optional filtering by user and pagination.

methods.name: safe_tag
methods.description: Creates or associates a normalized tag with an object and user, preventing duplicates based on configuration.

methods.name: normalize_tag
methods.description: Converts a raw tag string into its normalized form based on configured rules (lowercasing and character filtering).

methods.name: delete_object_tag
methods.description: Removes a specific tag from an object for a given user.

methods.name: delete_all_object_tags
methods.description: Deletes all tags associated with an object.

methods.name: delete_all_object_tags_for_user
methods.description: Deletes all tags for an object for a specific user.

methods.name: get_tag_id
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a tag based on its normalized form.

methods.name: get_raw_tag_id
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a tag based on its raw form.

methods.name: tag_object
methods.description: Tags an object with a string of tags, parsing and adding each via safe_tag method.

methods.name: _tag_object_array
methods.description: Internal method to tag an object with an array of tags.

methods.name: _parse_tags
methods.description: Parses a string into tags, handling quoted phrases and splitting by whitespace.

methods.name: update_tags
methods.description: Placeholder comment for a method to update tags en masse.

methods.name: get_most_popular_tags
methods.description: Returns the most popular tags with optional user restriction, offset, and limit.

methods.name: count_tags
methods.description: Counts total tags in the system, optionally restricting by user.

methods.name: get_tag_cloud_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for a tag cloud with sizes proportional to tag popularity.

methods.name: get_tag_cloud_tags
methods.description: Returns tags and their counts for building tag clouds.

methods.name: similar_tags
methods.description: Finds tags related to a given tag by co-occurrence on objects, with a maximum number.

methods.name: similar_objects
methods.description: Finds objects similar to a given object based on shared tags, with a threshold for minimum common tags.

methods.name: debug_text
methods.description: Outputs debug information if debugging is enabled.
